gap_definition: distance from planar ground surface z=0 to lower apex of the hemispherical/capped HV needle

boundary_conditions.petsc: D2 app-local axisymmetric finite-volume PETSc solve with homogeneous Afivo-matched outer boundary: side Neumann zero, lower z Dirichlet 0, upper z Dirichlet applied voltage, plus structured electrode mask
boundary_conditions.afivo: standard_3d homogeneous potential boundary: side Neumann zero, bottom Dirichlet 0, top Dirichlet applied voltage, plus embedded HV rod

known_discretization_difference: PETSc uses an axisymmetric structured cell-center conductor mask; Afivo uses a Cartesian level-set electrode and AMR.
